name: Adaptive Bounding Box Computation
definition: Computes a tight bounding box for a 2D Gaussian splat based on opacity threshold, avoiding the wasteful circular bounding box of the original 3DGS method.
summary: Adaptive Bounding Box Computation calculates a tight, axis-aligned box for 2D Gaussian splats based on opacity, reducing false-positive tile intersections compared to the original circular bounding box.
